titulo: Nvidia will officially bring DLSS 5 to older GPUs — but won’t give gamers full control
cuerpo: Officially, Nvidia's controversial DLSS 5 AI rendering was supposed to launch this evening with only a single game, only on Nvidia's latest RTX 50 GPUs, and with developers in full control of their artistic vision.
